How to Read Mobile Legends Hero Stats

Understanding Mobile Legends win rate and pick/ban rate data helps you make better draft decisions. These MLBB hero statistics are calculated from aggregated Mobile Legends ranked match data and refresh daily from the runtime snapshot.

What the Stats Mean

Win RateThe percentage of ranked matches a hero wins. Heroes above 53% are strong picks on the tier list.
Pick RateHow often a hero is selected in ranked matches. High pick rate means the hero is popular and accessible to most players.
Ban RateHow often a hero is banned during draft. A high ban rate signals the hero is considered overpowered or frustrating to play against.

Using Win Rate Data in MLBB

1
High WR + Low PRA hidden gem. The hero is strong but underplayed, often because the kit is niche or difficult.
2
High WR + High BanA draft-warping hero. Strong enough that opponents actively ban it out. See where it lands on the MLBB tier list.
3
Low WR + High PRPopular but underperforming. Often new or flashy heroes that attract players despite weak stats.
4
Stats vary by rankA hero with 55% win rate in Epic may drop to 48% in Mythical Glory. Check counter matchups for context.

All statistics are derived from aggregated ranked match data across all mobilelegends.com servers. Ranked stats refresh daily. Last update: 2 minutes ago.

Frequently Asked Questions About MLBB Win Rates

The average win rate across all Mobile Legends heroes is close to 50%, since every match produces one winner and one loser. However, individual hero win rates range from around 44% to 58% depending on the hero’s current ranked performance. Heroes above 53% are generally considered strong picks.

A win rate above 53% is considered above average for a hero in MLBB. Heroes with 55%+ win rates are strong ranked performers. For individual players, a 55–60% win rate in ranked is good, and 60%+ is excellent. Win rates vary by rank bracket, with some heroes performing better in Epic/Legend than in Mythic.

Pick rate is the percentage of ranked matches where a hero is selected by either team. Ban rate is the percentage of matches where a hero is banned during the draft phase. High pick rate means a hero is popular, while high ban rate means the hero is considered too strong to let through.

The highest win rate heroes change with each patch. Check the "Highest Mobile Legends Win Rate by Role" section above for the current top 3 winners in each role. These rankings are based on real ranked match data and update automatically.

The most banned heroes change with each patch update. Use the full hero stats table above and sort by Ban Rate to see current top bans. You can also filter by rank bracket because ban priorities differ between Epic and Mythical Glory.

The hero stats table on this page shows pick rates for all heroes, sortable by column. Click the Pick Rate header to rank heroes from most to least picked. Filter by rank bracket to see how popularity changes across divisions.

Yes, hero statistics vary significantly by rank bracket. A hero may have a 55% win rate in Epic but only 48% in Mythical Glory, or vice versa. Use the rank filter on the stats table to compare performance across All Ranks, Epic, Legend, Mythic, Mythical Honor, and Mythical Glory.

The most picked hero changes with each patch and varies by rank. Check the "Most Picked MLBB Heroes" section above for the current top 10, or use the sortable table to sort all heroes by pick rate. Filter by rank bracket to see which heroes dominate at your skill level.
